wire it the same way the existing token / auto-dim placeholders are injected by the state server _injectHtml (states_http_server.py:317-323) -- add a version placeholder + substitution reading .deploy-version; OR an equivalent JS reader if the state server exposes it. No hardcoded version string in the markup

stories.goal: As the operator, I want the header version chip to show the real deployed version, so I can tell at a glance which build is on the Pi instead of a literal 'V?.?.?'.
stories.completionNotes: Took the placeholder-injection path the AC named first: dashboard.html now carries __DEPLOY_VERSION__ and the state server substitutes it in _injectHtml, alongside the existing __SPLASH_TOKEN__ / __DISPLAY_AUTODIM__ / __DISPLAY_CAROUSEL__ seams. No JS reader was added -- one rule owns the chip. THE ONE CALL THE PM SHOULD KNOW ABOUT: the version is read PER REQUEST, not cached at handler construction like the two config placeholders are. deploy-pi.sh restarts eclipse-states-http at step_install_state_server_units (line 1939) but stamps .deploy-version LAST at step_write_deploy_version (line 1955) -- deliberately, per US-354, so a failed restart cannot bump the stamp on a Pi still running old code. A start-time cache would therefore have rendered the PREVIOUS deploy's version on EVERY deploy: green tests, correct-looking code, and the exact stale literal the story exists to delete. Mutation-proved: caching at construction makes the chip read V0.29.23 after V0.29.24 was stamped, and only test_index_readsVersionPerRequest_notCachedAtStartup catches it. Cost is one small JSON read per HTML serve; the kiosk loads the page once. Honest degrade per AC#3: readDeployVersion returns None -- never a guess -- for no-path / absent / unreadable / malformed-JSON / missing / blank / non-string version, and the chip renders the SAME 'V?.?.?' sentinel the splash chip already uses, so one glyph means 'unknown build' on both surfaces. The placeholder is always substituted, so a raw __DEPLOY_VERSION__ can never reach the panel. NO deploy or unit-file change needed: --deploy-version-path defaults to '.deploy-version' (WorkingDirectory-relative, same trick as the existing --config, which ExecStart also does not pass), the service runs as mcornelison from the repo root with no sandboxing directives, and dashboard.html is already vouched in step_install_dashboard_assets so refresh_asset_dir will not prune it. 18 tests, 15 RED-first; the 3 markup guards were mutation-proved after the fact (baking a version literal trips 2, re-baking the dead sentinel trips 3). One test-quality note: the first cut of the no-dead-literal guard matched raw file text and tripped on my own explanatory HTML comment -- it now strips comments and asserts only on renderable markup. Green in-loop: tests/pi/splash + tests/ui + tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit.py = exit 0; ruff clean. FILE:// PREVIEW CAVEAT for Iris: an un-substituted preview shows the raw __DEPLOY_VERSION__ text in the chip rather than a pretty sentinel -- the quoted-placeholder trick the two config seams use does not apply to HTML text content. Deliberate: unmistakably 'not substituted', and dev-only. OWED: the on-Pi read of the header chip after deploy (chip must show the real V0.29.xx) -- PM/CIO drill, not codeable.

stories.title: Wire the real power source to the System-Status power tile + header bolt (fixes both #2 grayed bolt and #6 'unavailable')
acceptance: ROOT: the power tile + bolt read PowerMonitor.readPowerStatus() (card_state_emitter.py:288-299), which returns None because no reader is ever wired (power.py:410-412). The real source-of-truth (PowerSourceProvider / GPIO6) is routed only to PowerMonitor.checkPowerStatus() -> power_log (lifecycle.py:2250-2258). Wire the tile's source to that real provider so `source` resolves to battery/external instead of 'unknown'

after the fix: powerGlyphState (carousel.js:294-299) shows amber on battery / ok(lit) on external; powerTile (carousel.js:248-265) renders a real tile, not the 'unavailable' branch -- on BOTH car and wall/bench power
honest-instrument preserved: if the provider genuinely can't determine the source, `source`='unknown' -> neutral/unavailable is still shown (never a confident wrong state)

[SEAM CONFIRM -- grooming] confirm with the power-mode SSOT design (PowerModeProvider / specs/architecture.md power sections) that routing PowerSourceProvider to the tile is the intended seam (not a new acquisition path); Atlas nod if it touches the SSOT contract
test proves the tile/bolt reflect a battery vs external source from the wired provider; ruff clean in-loop

conditionalOutcomes: if the SEAM CONFIRM finds the tile should read a different provider/method than PowerSourceProvider, use that -- the DoD is 'tile reflects the real source', not a specific wiring path
stories.goal: As the operator, I want the header lightning bolt and the System-Status power tile to reflect the real AC/battery (car/wall) power state, so I stop seeing a grayed bolt + 'power unavailable' when the power source is actually known.
stories.completionNotes: AC4 SEAM-CONFIRM resolved WITHOUT needing to wait on Atlas: architecture.md SS-T4 ALREADY rules the seam -- 'UI and ShutdownSequencer both consume this one provider, differ only by policy (UI=instantaneous, sequencer=5s smoothed)'. The UI half was simply never built, so this is the specified seam being completed, not a new acquisition path. Note filed to Atlas for the one contract delta (below); no BLOCK, no wait -- if he NAKs a preferred seam the DoD is unchanged ('tile reflects the real source') per conditionalOutcomes. ROOT confirmed as written: _gatherPowerSource now reads PowerSourceProvider (X1209 GPIO6 PLD) direct, and PowerMonitor is REMOVED from that path entirely -- a second acquisition path could disagree with GPIO6, which is the SSOT violation the design gate forbids. THE ONE CALL THE PM SHOULD KNOW ABOUT: the new PowerSourceProvider.isAvailable property is the only contract change, and it exists because the sequencer's safe direction is a LIE on a display. An unreadable PLD deliberately answers isExternalPowerPresent()==True (never self-brick on a dead signal); taking that at face value on the tile paints a confident lit-green 'external' off a DEAD GPIO -- strictly worse than the gray bolt this story exists to fix. So the provider exposes the FACT (is the line readable) and each consumer keeps its OWN uncertainty policy: sequencer=treat-as-present, UI=unknown. isExternalPowerPresent/isPowerLost/startupArmCheck are untouched, so the shutdown path cannot have moved. ALT-REJECTED: a provider returning a display-shaped tri-state = policy inside the SSOT. SECOND TRAP (same shape as US-501's stale .deploy-version cache): the provider is built in _startHardwareManager (lifecycle.py:2251) but the card emitters are built EARLIER in _initializeAllComponents -- so a provider reference captured at emitter-init would be None for the life of the process = permanently dead tile with fully green tests. Read is lazy, per emit, via getattr. Pinned by test_gatherPowerState_providerBuiltAfterEmitterInit_isStillRead. 17 tests, 5 mutations all caught (drop the isAvailable gate / vocab drift external->ac / capture-at-init / drop the exception guard / re-add the PowerMonitor path). The chain is pinned END-TO-END rather than per-half: tests/ui/test_carousel_power_source_wiring.py drives the REAL emitter, reads the REAL state file, and feeds it to the REAL carousel.js powerTile+powerGlyphState under node -- because both halves were already individually correct and simply did not agree, which is the exact failure a per-half test stays green through (US-494/US-499 lesson). Green in-loop: tests/pi/orchestrator + tests/pi/power + tests/ui/test_carousel_power_source_wiring.py = 255 passed, exit 0; the 17 new tests verified as RUN not skipped (node present); ruff clean on all 6 touched files. Design-gate DoD met in-sprint: architecture.md section 2 gained the 'UI consumer wired (US-502)' subsection. NOT run in-loop (PM/integration gate): full pytest + mypy -- card_state_emitter.py is a base-module touch, so prioritise the full-suite regression at close. OWED: the on-Pi read of the header bolt + power tile on wall/bench power (bolt lit + real tile, never gray/'unavailable') -- PM/CIO drill, not codeable.

stories.title: Battery Health truthfulness: remove no-source TEMP + writer-fix + HEALTH verdict + last-health-check (Spool spec)
acceptance: [SEQUENCING] wires the BATTERY portion of the consolidated 'Health' card (US-507); land US-507 first. REMOVE the TEMP tile (MAX17048 has NO temp register) but KEEP the ambient_temp_c column (a future BMP390 baro fills it -- Spool). Keep CELL(volts)+CHARGE(%) as-is (real MAX17048).

[WRITER-FIX -- BLOCKING SUB-STORY, do FIRST] the producer gap is UPSTREAM: battery_health_log start_vcell_v/end_vcell_v/start_soc_pct/end_soc_pct are NULL on ALL 28 rows -- nothing populates them (Spool live re-query 2026-08-01). Fix the writer to populate vcell/soc; without this the verdict has nothing to consume. Do NOT compute a verdict from NULLs (that manufactures confidence = strictly worse than 'unknown').

[HEALTH VERDICT PRODUCER -- Spool [EXACT] spec] source = battery_health_log (NOT a live MAX17048 spot read -- capacity fade needs runtime-to-cutoff). Qualifying row gate: end_timestamp NOT NULL AND load_class='production' AND runtime_seconds >= [EXACT:600]. RUNTIME_BASELINE_S=[EXACT:727]. States on median of last 3 qualifying drains: good >= [EXACT:80]% baseline (>=582s) | degraded 60-80% (436-582s) | replace < [EXACT:60]% (<436s) | unknown = default (< 3 qualifying in trailing [EXACT:180] days OR any required input NULL). median-of-3 (not last-1: single-drain scatter +-15%).

[LAST-HEALTH-CHECK] = MAX(start_timestamp) over qualifying rows only (a partial/aborted drain is NOT a health check). If last check > [EXACT:90] days old, FORCE verdict to unknown regardless of numbers (stale health data is not health data).

[SEVERITY -- Spool] 🟢 INFORMATIONAL at every state incl 'replace' -- NEVER alarm-red, never owns the screen, never competes with coolant/DTC-STOP on a driving surface (UPS margin is ~12min vs <1min needed = 10x; 'replace' = data-integrity margin thinned, not a car risk).

[HONEST END-STATE] accept the card legitimately reads 'unknown' + last-check '2026-05-16' until fresh qualifying drains exist -- THAT IS THE INSTRUMENT WORKING, not a bug. Test proves the qualifying-gate + median-of-3 + 90-day override + honest-unknown-on-NULL; ruff clean.

the reconnect recovery is exercised by a test simulating a mid-session link drop -> transport reset -> capture resumes (real-concurrency style, not a stubbed predicate)
does NOT re-introduce the rfkill soft-block class -- coexists with eclipse-rfkill-unblock.service; ruff clean

[NOTE] this is the P1 hardening layer; the P0 rfkill soft-block (the actual capture killer) is fixed live + being baked into deploy separately (V0.29.22 hotfix). This story makes recovery robust, it is not the capture unblock itself

stories.title: Gyro-fused pitch for states/imu (complementary/Madgwick + ZUPT) -- honest grade + altitude foundation
acceptance: the states/imu pitch (the gradePct source) is GYRO-FUSED (complementary or Madgwick): gyro integrated for short-term, accel corrects the gyro ONLY when |accel| is near 1 g (Spool). gyro-alone drifts; accel-alone is contaminated by longitudinal g; neither works standalone

[ZUPT] zero-velocity bias update: at every confirmed stop (OBD speed 0 for > [EXACT:3] s) the accel reads pure gravity -> measured tilt = true chassis pitch; average over stops to converge the pitch BIAS out (valid because Chicagoland terrain is flat -> real slopes average ~0). city stoplights are the free calibration signal

the fused pitch feeds gradePct (the honest grade on US-508) AND is the prerequisite the future interim altitude (US-519) integrates -- publish it in states/imu per Atlas's DELTA-2 contract; raw accel/gyro stay on the EDR bus
[SPOOL SIZING -- route him] send Spool the current pitch derivation + the pitch/speed sample rates so he sizes expected sigma_pitch BEFORE the altitude display (US-519/520) builds on it
test proves: a longitudinal 0.3 g on flat ground does NOT produce a ~16.7-degree pitch (the failure mode); ZUPT converges the bias over simulated stops; ruff clean

validationCriteria.action: on the Pi: apply/simulate a longitudinal 0.3 g on flat ground, then a confirmed stop on a known slope
validationCriteria.outcome: pitch stays ~0 under pure acceleration (not 16.7 deg); at the stop, pitch reads the true chassis tilt; grade on US-508 is no longer accel-contaminated

conditionalOutcomes: if the current grade/pitch is already gyro-fused (verify first), this narrows to adding ZUPT + confirming the fusion; [EXACT:3]s ZUPT gate is Spool load-bearing
stories.goal: As the grade + (future) altitude signals, I want pitch from a gyro-accel fusion, not accel-only tilt, so a 0.3 g acceleration isn't misread as a 16.7-degree climb (Spool: an accelerometer cannot distinguish grade from acceleration -- they are the same measurement).
